operations.description: Measure PL from 80 to 430 K. Fit spectra with Lorentzian functions and extract PL peak energy, FWHM and intensity. The observed trend changes are assigned to γ-tetragonal-1 → β-tetragonal-2 at 140 K and β → α-cubic at 250 K. These are source interpretations supported by optical/Raman trends, not variable-temperature coordinate refinements on the QDs. Observation or comparison context, not an acquisition setpoint: gamma-beta transition = 140 K. Observation or comparison context, not an acquisition setpoint: beta-alpha transition = 250 K. Inputs denote separate source specimens or datasets, not a physically pooled mixture. Synthesis nitrogen is not inherited by acquisition. Unreported: See source acquisition missingness G5.
